macros.name: boxedshape
macros.doc: A specific formatting has been predefined to create a lightly shaded box around the title: \boxedshape{⟨text⟩} (thanks to the fancybox package by Timothy Van Zandt).

macros.name: correct
macros.doc: To typeset a correct version of an exercise sheet, we provide the \correct macro, which adds “ – Correct Version” to the title.

macros.name: footstyle
macros.doc: The \headstyle and \footstyle commands are common for all headers and footers components, respectively.

macros.name: maketitle
macros.doc: The macro has on optional parameter \maketitle[⟨rulelength⟩] to define the length of the separation rule, which is 2.5 cm by default.

macros.name: pagenamestyle
macros.doc: Note that \pagenamestyle determines the format of the word “page” displayed preceding the page number.

macros.name: subtitle
macros.doc: Within the exam style, the title includes an additional field provided by the macro \subtitle{⟨text⟩}.

macros.name: title
macros.doc: The \title macro has been extended with an enriched syntax: \title[⟨head⟩]{⟨title⟩}. The optional parameter ⟨head⟩ corresponds to the text displayed in the header instead of ⟨title⟩.

macros.name: titlesep
macros.doc: The length \titlesep determines the vertical spacing between the title and subject fields, except for the classic and soft styles, witch contain only the title field, or when the subject field is not provided.
